processing.downmixRationale: front ORTF L/R of the ORTF 3D master
processing.channelBalanceRationale: measured standing L/R difference, halved onto each channel: the cabin really is louder on one side, but a bed played for eight hours should not leave one ear hotter all night
processing.loudnorm: two-pass linear, I=-23.90 LUFS, TP=-1.0 dBTP, LRA=11
processing.loopStartRationale: start chosen so the 6s before the wrap and the 6s after it sit at the same level at P=409s; trimming from 0 put a fade-in against a settled tail

notes: Downmixed (front-pair) and levelled by tools/level-ftus.py. Seamless-looped to 409s (prime loopOffset) for native Howler looping: 6s fade-wrap of the post-loop tail over the head so the loop point is gapless. Encoded as Opus (128k) — see DECISIONS.md 'Ship scene audio as Opus, not MP3'.
chosenBy: Andrew by ear, 2026-09-30, over the Guangzhou hotel-window take (#13925), whose middle has loud honks. Replaces glass-1 (Pixabay, mono), which carried the 1am rooster.
